content.what_it_is: MATLAB video script comparing a propeller run and a no-propeller run over outputs 1-75. It sizes a 2 m grid from dep_00000 (L2-L17), opens a 10 fps MPEG-4 writer, then loads eta, concentration, and sediment-change arrays from both runs; renders eta plus no-propeller/propeller concentration panels; rasterizes the figure; and appends frames to videoOut.mp4 (L20-L88).

no-propeller directory fdir1 defined at L3

grid dimensions n and m defined at L8
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L10-L11
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L12-L13
frame vector nfile defined at L17
FrameRate and Quality fields assigned at L21-L22

unresolved: Graphics-state accumulation defect across L30 and L47-L77: clf runs only once before the frame loop, while every subplot executes hold on and never clears or releases it. Each iteration therefore layers another pcolor and creates additional colorbars on persistent axes, causing growing memory/object counts and stale stacked graphics across the 75-frame video.

Loaded-data/output mismatch at L36-L44 versus L46-L77: eta1, ds, db, ds1, and db1 are never consumed; despite the file's morph name, sediment-change fields do not affect any panel, and only propeller eta plus the two concentration arrays are displayed.

Potential concentration-scale mismatch at L60/L72 and L62/L74: concentration is multiplied by 100 but both color axes remain [0,0.01], which corresponds to an unscaled range [0,0.0001]. The colorbar is still labeled only 'c', so intended fraction-versus-percent units are unresolved.
All propeller/no-propeller arrays are plotted on coordinates sized from output/dep_00000 at L5-L13 without shape checks; a mismatched comparison run fails or misaligns.
MATLAB pcolor at L47, L60, and L72 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces.
